name: Fitness Studio Operations

topic: trial conversion and instructor coverage for fitness studios

products.name: Trial Member Follow-Up
products.product: A focused fitness studio trial follow-up workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: boutique fitness studios and group-class operators
products.problem: Trial visitors enter through forms, class bookings, guest passes, and walk-ins, but staff cannot see who attended, what they wanted, or whether someone followed up.
products.valueProposition: Turns fitness studio trial follow-up into a visible operating queue so every attended trial receives one relevant membership next step or a documented no-contact outcome.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets gym trial follow up, fitness studio lead tracker, trial class conversion, and boutique fitness sales workflow searches.

products.name: Instructor Cover Board
products.product: A focused fitness instructor substitution tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: boutique fitness studios and group-class operators
products.problem: Instructor absences are solved in group chats, so managers may not know whether a qualified substitute, access instructions, payroll changes, and member notices are all complete.
products.valueProposition: Turns fitness instructor substitution tracking into a visible operating queue so every instructor absence is covered by an eligible substitute or escalated to a documented class change before members arrive.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets fitness instructor substitute, gym class coverage app, instructor sub request, and fitness class cancellation workflow searches.
